input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Airy, magical climbing music for a sky level among giant beanstalk leaves and clouds in a 3D adventure game. Twinkling celesta arpeggios, flowing harp glissandi, soaring legato strings that keep rising upward, a soft flute melody, wordless airy synth-choir pads, light brushed percussion. A feeling of wonder, height and floating castles; hopeful and bright, about 104 BPM, constant motion, no ending, loop-friendly game background music.
